# FG-INT-0017

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`integrations`](../../ops/runbooks/integrations.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `binding_a_disabled_integration_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この連携は今は使えません（連携かそのサービスアカウントが無効です）。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: This integration cannot be used now (the integration or its service account is disabled). Contact the administrator.
- id: Integrasi ini tidak dapat digunakan sekarang (integrasi atau akun layanannya dinonaktifkan). Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A bind named an integration that is disabled (`integrations.enabled = false`: an administrator stopped it, runbook integrations C) or whose service account is disabled (I1a review: a bind grants that account a Reporter membership, so a stopped integration must not gain projects, and a disabled account must not collect memberships that come alive when it is enabled again). Both are read under the integration's row lock and the account's row lock (FOR SHARE), so a disable that commits first is seen. Nothing was written. Unbinding still works for a disabled integration (it only takes access away).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (`integration_disabled` or `service_account_disabled`), `integration_id`, `service_account_id` and `project_id`, with `action=IntegrationBindingManage`. `gstn admin integration view <integration_id> --json` shows `enabled` and the service account; `gstn admin service-account view <service_account_id>` shows its `state`.

## 対処 (fix)

If the stop was intended, nothing to do. Otherwise, after checking why it was stopped (runbook integrations, service-accounts), an administrator enables the integration again in the browser session (`PATCH /api/v1/admin/integrations/{id}` with `enabled: true`) or enables its service account; then bind again.
